description: We are a team from Jakarta taking on Challenge 6. Our project, SBATS (Space Base Analog Terrain System), compares about 92,000 land squares across Earth with real Moon and Mars sites using NASA and partner data. Pick a site, and SBATS shows where on Earth matches it, why, and what Earth cannot copy. We also test Indonesian volcanoes like Tambora and Batur as new analog candidates. Team: Prabu, Eliana, Mubashir, Eibee.
